title: DME-TIR-Interval: reproducible assessment-schedule sensitivity analysis
description: Analysis code, frozen configurations and synthetic tests for within-eye assessment-schedule sensitivity of first-year visual-acuity time in range in DRCR Protocol T and AC. No participant-level datasets are redistributed. Original data must be obtained separately from the official DRCR public data portal. Includes participant-cluster bootstrap, holdout validation, prespecified sensitivity analyses and separately labeled post hoc clinical extensions.
